==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/æz fə/}}
* {{IPA|en|/æz fɔːɹ/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-as for.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-TranqyPoo-as for.wav|a=US,General American}}

===Preposition===
{{en-head|prep}}

# [[regarding|Regarding]]; [[about]]; [[concerning]].
#: {{ux|en|I can't teach that class today: I'm sick. '''As for''' the rest of the teachers, they are still on leave.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''As for''' you, we believe in you.}}
#* {{RQ:Orwell Animal Farm|3
|passage=''' As for''' the pigs, they could already read and write perfectly.}}

====Usage notes====
* ''As for'' is almost always put at the beginning of a sentence.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|as to}}, {{l|en|apropos}}; See also [[Thesaurus:about]]
